examples.text: tath'eva katapuññam'pi, asmā lokā paraṃ gataṃ, puññāni paṭigaṇhanti, piyaṃ ñātī'va āgataṃ.
tuvaṃ h'etaṃ pajānāsi, puññakkhettaṃ anuttaraṃ, amham'pi ete samaṇā, paṭigaṇhanti dakkhiṇaṃ.
tayi gedhitacitto'smi, cittaṃ vipariṇāmitaṃ, paṭigantuṃ na sakkomi, vaṅkaghasto'va ambujo.

40312.meaning2: receiving, receiver, able to hold in

examples.text: so patt'odakaṃ paṭiggaṇhanto na pattaṃ unnāmeti, na pattaṃ onāmeti, na pattaṃ sannāmeti, na pattaṃ vināmeti. so patt'odakaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti n'ātithokaṃ n'ātibahuṃ.

40314.synonym: uggaṇhāti, upagacchati, gaṇhati, gaṇhāti, paṭiggahāti, lāti, sampaṭicchati

examples.text: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, idaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ, paṭiggaṇhātu āyasmā cīvaracetāpannan'ti.
seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva tesaṃ caturāsītipāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi

40315.commentary: (ANa) taṃ te mayaṃ paṭiggaṇhāmā'ti taṃ tava aparādhaṃ mayaṃ khamāma.

examples.text: accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā, yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, y'āhaṃ evam'akāsiṃ. tassā me, bhante, ayyo ānando accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu, āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.
dvattipattapūre paṭiggahetvā tato nikkhamantena bhikkhuṃ passitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ, amutra mayā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahitā, mā kho paṭiggaṇhī'ti.

40318.meaning2: to take; to receive; to accept

examples.text: te vuttavākyā rājāno, paṭiggayha-anusāsaniṃ, vippasannamanā santā, aṭṭhaṃsu samhi āsane'ti.
ajjhenāni paṭiggayha, kāmesu gadhito ahaṃ, acariṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ, paresaṃ ahitāyahaṃ.

40321.synonym: ādhāra, upadhāna, dhi, nidhāna, piṭhara, pīṭhara
40321.commentary: (VINa) paṭiggahe vā'ti paṭiggahena paṭicchanto naṃ paṭiggahe chaḍḍeti.

examples.text: anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, uddharitvā vā bhinditvā vā paṭiggahe vā nīharitvā vā chaḍḍeti, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anavasesadohī hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ saddhā gahapatikā abhihaṭṭhuṃ pavārenti cīvara-piṇḍapāta-sen'āsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārehi. tatra bhikkhu mattaṃ na jānāti paṭiggahaṇāya.
aj'eḷakapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kukkuṭasūkarapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, hatthi-gav'assa-vaḷava-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, khettavatthupaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ.

40324.commentary: (DNa) sakkaccaṃ sippapaṭiggahaṇenā'ti sakkaccaṃ paṭiggahaṇaṃ nāma thokaṃ gahetvā bahuvāre sajjhāyakaraṇaṃ, ekapadam'pi visuddham'eva gahetabbaṃ.

examples.text: pañcahi kho, gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi antevāsinā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā, uṭṭhānena upaṭṭhānena sussusāya pāricariyāya sakkaccaṃ sippapaṭiggahaṇena

40326.commentary: (VINa) kāle paṭiggahitan'ti-ādīsu majjh'anhike avītivatte paṭiggahetvā pacitvā parissāvetvā cā'ti attho.

examples.text: dvattipattapūre paṭiggahetvā tato nikkhamantena bhikkhuṃ passitvā ācikkhitabbaṃ, amutra mayā dvattipattapūrā paṭiggahitā, mā kho tattha paṭiggaṇhī'ti.
idaṃ me, bhante, cīvaraṃ aññātikāya bhikkhuniyā hatthato paṭiggahitaṃ, aññatra pārivattakā, nissaggiyaṃ. im'āhaṃ saṅghassa nissajjāmī'ti
katame, bhikkhave, cattāro mah'āpadesā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu evaṃ vadeyya, sammukhā m'etaṃ, āvuso, bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, ayaṃ dhammo, ayaṃ vinayo, idaṃ satthusāsanan'ti.
sammukhā kho pana m'etaṃ bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ, abhay'ūparato'ham'asmi, n'āham'asmi bhay'ūparato, vītarāgattā kāme na sevāmi khayā rāgassā'ti.

40328.meaning1: (vinaya) formally accepted; received by a monastic

examples.text: paṭiggahitake vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. paṭiggahitake paṭiggahitakasaññī, anāpatti.

40329.meaning1: (vinaya) formally accepted; received by a monk

examples.text: atirittaṃ nāma kappiyakataṃ hoti, paṭiggahitakataṃ hoti, uccāritakataṃ hoti, hatthapāse kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā kataṃ hoti, bhuttāvinā pavāritena āsanā avuṭṭhitena kataṃ hoti

40330.meaning1: perceiving as formally accepted; regarding (something) as received

examples.text: paṭiggahitake vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. paṭiggahitake paṭiggahitakasaññī, anāpatti.

40331.meaning1: should be received (by); can be taken (by); acceptable (for)

examples.text: disvāna aññam'aññaṃ saṇṭhapesuṃ, ayaṃ kho, āvuso, samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya. so n'eva abhivādetabbo, na paccuṭṭhātabbo, n'āssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.
bhikkhuno pan'eva addhānamaggappaṭipannassa eḷakalomāni uppajjeyyuṃ, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbāni, paṭiggahetvā tiyojanaparamaṃ sahatthā haritabbāni asante hārake.

40332.meaning2: who accept, receives or takes, recipient

examples.text: ahaṃ kho pana, tāta uttara, mantānaṃ dātā, tvaṃ mantānaṃ paṭiggahetā'ti.

40333.synonym: uggaṇhāti, upagacchati, gaṇhati, gaṇhāti, paṭiggahāti, lāti, sampaṭicchati

examples.text: sakkaccaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na kho no, brāhmaṇa, kappati jātarūparajataṃ paṭiggahetun'ti. sace taṃ bhoto udenassa na kappati vihāraṃ bhoto udenassa kārāpessāmī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃnhāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā atimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttam'aṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhapeyya
tam'enaṃ aññataro puriso telamalikatena sāhuḷicīrena vañceyya, idaṃ te, ambho purisa, odātaṃ vatthaṃ abhirūpaṃ nimmalaṃ sucī'ti. so taṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, paṭiggahetvā pārupeyya.
sace yāgu hoti, bhājanaṃ dhovitvā yāgu upanāmetabbā. yāguṃ pītassa udakaṃ datvā bhājanaṃ paṭiggahetvā nīcaṃ katvā sādhukaṃ appaṭighaṃsantena dhovitvā paṭisāmetabbaṃ.
app'ekacce maṃ paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesuṃ, app'ekacce āsanaṃ paññapesuṃ, app'ekacce pād'odakaṃ upaṭṭhapesuṃ. api ca kho maṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti.
atha kho āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā, eko bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi, eko āsanaṃ paññapesi, eko pād'odakaṃ upaṭṭhāpesi

40339.meaning1: expected destination; place which will receive one
40339.commentary: (ANa) paṭiggāhā'ti paṭiggāhakā, dussīlaṃ puggalaṃ dve ṭhānāni paṭiggaṇhantī'ti attho.

examples.text: dussīlassa, bhikkhave, dve paṭiggāhā, nirayo vā tiracchānayoni vā. sīlavato, bhikkhave, dve paṭiggāhā, devā vā manussā vā'ti.
kathañ'c'ānanda, dakkhiṇā dāyakato visujjhati no paṭiggāhakato? idh'ānanda, dāyako hoti sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo, paṭiggāhakā honti dussīlā pāpadhammā
sace so tena parivattetvā kappiyaṃ āharati rūpiyappaṭiggāhakaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbeh'eva paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigha-anusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti
upekkhaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. upekkhañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato yo paṭigho so pahīyissati.

40344.meaning1: (sense) impression; impingement; impact; (comm) existence in the realm of sense desire
40344.commentary: (SNa) paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā cā'ti ettha paṭighasaññāvasena kāmabhavo gahito, rūpasaññāvasena rūpabhavo. tesu dvīsu gahitesu arūpabhavo gahito'va hoti bhavasaṅkhepenā'ti.

examples.text: yattha nāmañ'ca rūpañ'ca, asesaṃ uparujjhati, paṭighaṃ rūpasaññā ca, etth'esā chijjate jaṭā'ti.
idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma

40345.meaning1: disliked image in the mind; mental image which irritates one

examples.text: paṭighanimittaṃ, bhikkhave, ayoniso manasi karoto anuppanno c'eva byāpādo uppajjati uppanno ca byāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatī'ti
ko ca, bhikkhave, āhāro anuppannassa vā byāpādassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā byāpādassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya? atthi, bhikkhave, paṭighanimittaṃ.

40346.meaning1: recognition of sense impression; perception of sense impact
40346.commentary: (Abh Vibh 6.3) cakkh'ādīnaṃ vatthūnaṃ rūp'ādīnaṃ ārammaṇānañ'ca paṭighātena samuppannā saññā paṭighasaññā. rūpasaññ'ādīnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. rūpasaññā saddasaññā gandhasaññā rasasaññā phoṭṭhabbasaññā, imā vuccanti paṭighasaññāyo'ti

examples.text: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma

40347.commentary: (SNPa) byārosanā paṭighasaññā'ti kāyavacīvikārehi byārosanāya ca, manovikārena paṭighasaññāya ca.

examples.text: na paro paraṃ nikubbetha, n'ātimaññetha katthaci naṃ kañci, byārosanā paṭighasaññā, n'āññam'aññassa dukkham'iccheyya.

40348.meaning1: bond of repulsion; fetter of resistance
40348.commentary: (NIDD1a) paṭighasaññojanā'ti byāpādasaññojanā. so hi ārammaṇe paṭihaññatī'ti paṭighan'ti vuccati. te eva thāmagat'aṭṭhena santāne anusentī'ti anusayā.

examples.text: satta saññojanāni, anunayasaññojanaṃ, paṭighasaññojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaññojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaññojanaṃ, mānasaññojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaññojanaṃ, avijjāsaññojanaṃ.

yehi, ānanda, ākārehi yehi liṅgehi yehi nimittehi yehi uddesehi nāmakāyassa ca rūpakāyassa ca paññatti hoti, tesu ākāresu tesu liṅgesu tesu nimittesu tesu uddesesu asati api nu kho adhivacanasamphasso vā paṭighasamphasso vā paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

40350.meaning1: bond of repulsion; fetter of aversion

examples.text: satta saṃyojanāni, anunayasaṃyojanaṃ, paṭighasaṃyojanaṃ, diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ, vicikicchāsaṃyojanaṃ, mānasaṃyojanaṃ, bhavarāgasaṃyojanaṃ, avijjāsaṃyojanaṃ.

so dve vedanā vedayati, kāyikañ'ca, cetasikañ'ca. tassā'y'eva kho pana dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno paṭighavā hoti. tam'enaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavantaṃ, yo dukkhāya vedanāya paṭigh'ānusayo, so anuseti.

yena kho, jīvaka, rāgena yena dosena yena mohena vihesavā assa arativā assa paṭighavā assa so rāgo so doso so moho tathāgatassa pahīno ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.

40352.meaning1: due to aversion; because of resistance

40353.meaning1: warding off; repelling; driving off; keeping at bay (of)
40353.commentary: (VINa) samparāyikānaṃ āsavānaṃ paṭighātāyā'ti samparāyikā āsavā nāma asaṃvare ṭhitena katapāpakammamūlakā samparāye narak'ādīsu pattabbā dukkhavisesā, tesaṃ paṭighāt'atthāya paṭippassambhan'atthāya vūpasam'atthāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cīvaraṃ paṭisevati, yāva'd'eva sītassa paṭighātāya, uṇhassa paṭighātāya, ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya, yāva'd'eva hirikopīnappaṭicchādan'atthaṃ
yato ca kho, sāriputta, idh'ekacce āsavaṭṭhānīyā dhammā saṅghe pātubhavanti, atha satthā sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññapeti uddissati pātimokkhaṃ tesaṃ'y'eva āsavaṭṭhānīyānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭighātāya.
ete ca ñatvā satimā sumedho, avekkhati vipariṇāmadhamme, iṭṭhassa dhammā na mathenti cittaṃ, aniṭṭhato no paṭighātam'eti.

40356.meaning1: underlying tendency to aversion; inherent inclination to resistance
40356.commentary: (MNa) paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā'ti paṭigh'ānusayañ'ca sabb'ākāren'eva nīharitvā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. ettāvatā anāgāmimaggo kathito.

examples.text: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti
kāmarāg'ānusayassa… paṭigh'ānusayassa… diṭṭh'ānusayassa… vicikicch'ānusayassa… mān'ānusayassa… bhavarāg'ānusayassa… avijj'ānusayassa pahānāya samucchedāya brahmacariyaṃ vussati.

40357.meaning1: having the underlying tendency to aversion; with the inherent inclination to resistance

examples.text: dukkhaṃ vedayamānassa, vedanaṃ appajānato, paṭigh'ānusayo hoti, anissaraṇadassino.
tathā hi mukhaghos'ādīhi paccayehi aññasmiṃ dese ādāsapabbatappades'ādike paṭibimba-paṭighos'ādikaṃ paccayuppannaṃ nibbattamānaṃ dissati, tasmā na sabbaṃ sabbattha upanetabban'ti ayam'ettha saṅkhepo.
khīṇ'āsavo, bhante, bhikkhu vusitavā katakaraṇīyo, karaṇīyaṃ attano asamanupassanto, katassa vā paṭicayaṃ, khayā rāgassa vītarāgattā nekkhamm'ādhimutto hoti
tassa sammā vimuttassa, santacittassa bhikkhuno, katassa paṭicayo n'atthi, karaṇīyaṃ na vijjati.

40360.meaning2: goes about, evades a question, obscures a matter of discussion
40360.commentary: (ANa) aññen'aññaṃ paṭicaratī'ti aññena vacanena aññaṃ paṭicchādeti, aññaṃ vā pucchito aññaṃ katheti

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti. so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññen'āññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.
sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

40362.meaning2: went about, evaded a question, obscured a matter of discussion

examples.text: abhijānām'ahaṃ, bho gotama, pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabhitā. so'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññen'aññaṃ paṭicari, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsi.
tesaṃ, bhante, gopakena devaputtena paṭicoditānaṃ dve devā diṭṭh'eva dhamme satiṃ paṭilabhiṃsu kāyaṃ brahmapurohitaṃ, eko pana devo kāme ajjhāvasi.

sammāsambuddhassa te paṭijānato ime dhammā anabhisambuddhā'ti. tatra vata maṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṃ sahadhammena paṭicodessatī'ti nimittam'etaṃ, sāriputta, na samanupassāmi.
āsādan'āpekkho'ti iminā imaṃ codessāmi sāressāmi paṭicodessāmi paṭisāressāmi maṅku karissāmī'ti abhiharati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

40366.meaning1: having blamed; having rebuked; having reprimanded
40366.meaning2: having blamed in return, having reproved

examples.text: ath'assa pacchato āgacchanto'pi tiṭṭhati. so ayaṃ bhikkhu tuyhaṃ uppannavitakkaṃ jānāti, ananucchavikaṃ te etan'ti attānaṃ paṭicodetvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā tatth'eva ariyabhūmiṃ okkamati. tathā asakkonto nisīdati.

te amhākaṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ āgate amhākaṃ pāricariyaṃ gopako devaputto paṭicodesi, kutomukhā nāma tumhe, mārisā, tassa bhagavato dhammaṃ assuttha, ahañ'hi nāma itthikā samānā buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī itthittaṃ virājetvā purisattaṃ bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannā

40368.meaning1: dependent; depending (on); contingent (upon); relying (on); because (of); supported (by); on account (of); grounded (on)
40368.meaning2: on account of, because of, concerning

examples.text: yaṃ rūpaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa assādo. yaṃ rūpaṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ rūpassa ādīnavo.
iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttan'ti.

40370.meaning1: done on somebody's behalf; of which one is the cause of the action
40370.meaning2: action depending on (someone); action for which one is a cause

examples.text: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman'ti.

40371.meaning1: (comm) who receives the result of the action
40371.commentary: (MNa) atha vā paṭiccakamman'ti nimittakammass'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ, taṃ paṭicca kammam'ettha atthī'ti maṃsaṃ paṭiccakamman'ti vuttaṃ hoti yo evarūpaṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati, so'pi tassa kammassa dāy'ādo hoti, vadhakassa viya tassā'pi pāṇaghātakammaṃ hotī'ti tesaṃ laddhi.

examples.text: sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ uddissa pāṇaṃ ārabhanti, taṃ samaṇo gotamo jānaṃ uddissakataṃ maṃsaṃ paribhuñjati paṭiccakamman'ti.

40372.meaning1: arisen together from a cause; causally produced; dependently arisen
40372.meaning2: evolved by reason of the law of causation

examples.text: tañ'ca kho saṅkhataṃ oḷārikaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ
paṭiccasamuppannaṃ kho, āvuso, sukhadukkhaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā. kiṃ paṭicca? phassaṃ paṭicca. iti vadaṃ vuttavādī c'eva bhagavato assa, na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkheyya

40373.meaning1: arising together from a cause; chain of causation; dependent origination
40373.commentary: (MNa) yo paṭiccasamuppādaṃ passatī'ti yo paccaye passati. so dhammaṃ passatī'ti so paṭiccasamuppannadhamme passati

examples.text: vuttaṃ kho pan'etaṃ bhagavatā, yo paṭiccasamuppādaṃ passati so dhammaṃ passati, yo dhammaṃ passati so paṭiccasamuppādaṃ passatī'ti.
tatra bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaṃ'y'eva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasi karoti

40374.meaning1: skilled in the chain of causation; expert in dependent origination

examples.text: yato kho, ānanda, bhikkhu dhātukusalo ca hoti, āyatanakusalo ca hoti, paṭiccasamuppādakusalo ca hoti, ṭhān'āṭhānakusalo ca hoti, ettāvatā kho, ānanda, paṇḍito bhikkhu vīmaṃsako'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

40375.commentary: (DNa) paṭiccasamuppādakusalatā'ti avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā… samudayo hotī'ti yā tattha paññā pajānanā'ti (dha. sa. 1343) evaṃ vuttā dvādasannaṃ paccayākārānaṃ uggah'ādi-vasena pavattā paññā.

examples.text: āyatanakusalatā ca paṭiccasamuppādakusalatā ca.

40376.meaning1: seeing the chain of causation; observing dependent origination
40376.commentary: (MNa) paṭiccasamuppādadassā'ti iminā paccayena evaṃ hotī'ti evaṃ paṭiccasamuppādadassāvino.

examples.text: evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ, kammaṃ passanti paṇḍitā, paṭiccasamuppādadassā, kammavipākakovidā.

40378.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of paṭiccasamuppāda
40378.meaning1: as arising together from a cause; according to chain of causation; by way of dependent origination

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu dhātuso upaparikkhati, āyatanaso upaparikkhati, paṭiccasamuppādaso upaparikkhati. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu tividh'ūpaparikkhī hoti.

40379.commentary: (THa) paṭicchāmī'ti kassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā ovādadhammaṃ paṭiggaṇhāmi paṭipajjāmi.

examples.text: ko so pāraṅ'gato loke, ko patto amat'ogadhaṃ, kassa dhammaṃ paṭicchāmi, param'atthavijānanaṃ.

40380.synonym: gaṇhati, gaṇhāti, paṭigaṇhati, paṭigaṇhāti, paṭiggaṇhāti, paṭiggahāti, paṭiggaheti, patigaṇhāti, patiggaṇhāti, lāti, sampaṭicchati

examples.text: sāgāresu ca cīvaraṃ, paccayaṃ sayan'āsanaṃ, anagārā paṭicchanti, parissayavinodanaṃ.
kiñ'c'āpi so kamma karoti pāpakaṃ, kāyena vācā uda cetasā vā, abhabba so tassa paṭicchadāya, abhabbatā diṭṭhapadassa vuttā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītināgasahassāni ahesuṃ sovaṇṇ'ālaṅ'kārāni sovaṇṇaddhajāni hemajālapaṭicchannāni uposathanāgarājappamukhāni.

40383.synonym: āvaṭa, āvuṭa, guḷha, chādita, nilīna, līna, saṃvuta

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti.
ayaṃ loko kena āvuto nivuto ovuto, pihito paṭicchanno paṭikujjito'ti, kenassu nivuto loko?
yo katvā pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, mā maṃ jaññā'ti icchati, yo paṭicchannakamm'anto, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

40385.meaning1: with concealed deeds; who is furtive in action; who is underhanded in business; (comm) bad deed
40385.commentary: (ANa) paṭicchannakamm'antassā'ti pāpakammassa. pāpaṃ hi paṭicchādetvā karonti. no ce'pi paṭicchādetvā karonti, pāpakammaṃ paṭicchannam'evā'ti vuccati.

examples.text: yo katvā pāpakaṃ kammaṃ, mā maṃ jaññā'ti icchati, yo paṭicchannakamm'anto, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo dussīlo hoti pāpadhammo asuci saṅkassarasamācāro paṭicchannakamm'anto, assamaṇo samaṇapaṭiñño, abrahmacārī brahmacāripaṭiñño, antopūti avassuto kasambujāto.
kiñ'c'āpi so kamma karoti pāpakaṃ, kāyena vācā uda cetasā vā, abhabba so tassa paṭicchādāya, abhabbatā diṭṭhapadassa vuttā, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

40392.commentary: (NIDD1a) hirikopīnan'ti taṃ taṃ sambādhaṭṭhānaṃ. yasmiṃ yasmiñ'hi aṅge vivariyamāne hirī kuppati vinassati, taṃ taṃ hiriṃ kopanato hirikopīnan'ti vuccati. tassa ca hirikopīnassa paṭicchādan'atthan'ti hirikopīnapaṭicchādan'atthaṃ. hirikopīnaṃ paṭicchādan'atthan'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu paṭisaṅkhā yoniso cīvaraṃ paṭisevati, yāva'd'eva sītassa paṭighātāya, uṇhassa paṭighātāya, ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīṃsapa-samphassānaṃ paṭighātāya, yāva'd'eva hirikopīnappaṭicchādana-atthaṃ

yattha pana mahantaṃ paribhavaṃ paṭilabhati, tattha ciram'pi vasati. so nivatth'avatthe jiṇṇe pilotikakhaṇḍena tasmim'pi jiṇṇe kenaci dinnaṃ aggaṇhanto hirikopīnapaṭicchādanamatten'eva carati. evaṃ gacchante kāle ekaṃ nigamagāmaṃ agamāsi.

40395.grammar: ind, adv, comp, dat sg of paṭicchādanattha (+gen)

examples.text: kaṇḍuppaṭicchādi nāma yassa adhonābhi ubbhajāṇumaṇḍalaṃ kaṇḍu vā pīḷakā vā assāvo vā thullakacchu vā ābādho, tassa paṭicchādan'atthāya.

40396.meaning1: in order to conceal; to hide

examples.text: so tassa vacīduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu… so tassa manoduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu… mā maṃ jaññū'ti kāyena parakkamati. idam'assa vaḍḍhiyā vadāmi.

40399.grammar: abs of caus of pati √chad, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: rājā pañcasate naggasamaṇake gāhāpetvā pañcasatehi corehi saddhiṃ rāj'aṅgaṇe nābhippamāṇesu āvāṭesu nikhaṇāpetvā palālehi paṭicchādāpetvā aggiṃ dāpesi.
